title: Following bands as a child; Bebe Matthews and the church
summary: He followed bands and loved drummer Bebe Matthews with Manuel Perez's band, which came to the church near his home.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yes. Can you tell me when you first heard music, when you got interested in music and what?

Oh, I used to follow the bands when they played the fumes and different things and I got interested in the drums. And I used to like to hear this fellow, Bebe, used to play drums for the, I forgot what band it was, Manny Perez band.
Bebe Matthews from over the river.
And I used to like to see him, I used to follow him all the time.
Did he play snare drum or? Snare drum. Uh-huh. That was with Manuel Perez. Right. Is that what they called the Onward Band or do you remember?
Yeah, I think it was. I was quite small. You know.
Is that over in your neighborhood, those Perez?
Yeah, all around used to come to the church, right around the corner from my home.
That was Morris Brown Church on Zurich Street.
What kind of a church? It was a Baptist church. Baptist church, yeah. Did you all belong to that church? No, I was Catholic. You were Catholic.
